subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

Getting a sudden promotion and increment in my current profile was like _________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **a bolt from the blue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"a bolt from the blue"** means something unexpected or surprising. (आकस्मिक घटना)

 
 
• **Example: **The news of his resignation came like a bolt from the blue.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that receiving an unexpected promotion and rise in my current role was unexpected.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **a bolt from the blue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **a ballpark figure **(अनुमानित आंकड़ा): An approximate or rough estimate.

 
 
• **Example:** Can you give me a ballpark figure of the total cost?
 
 
 
• **a foul play** (बेईमानी): Dishonest or treacherous behaviour.
 
 
• **Example: **The police suspected foul play in the mysterious death.
 
 

 
• **"a fish out of water" **refers to someone who is in an unfamiliar or uncomfortable situation. (अजीब स्थिति में होना)

 
 
• **Example: **He felt like a fish out of water at his new job.
